cards.title: Yale Professor Warns Nvidia's Huang Return Is Mistake
cards.body: Jeffrey Sonnenfeld argues Jensen Huang's reinstatement as CEO could expose board members to historic personal liability from lawsuits. The move contradicts what market observers initially celebrated as a White House-backed leadership decision.

cards.title: Huang Rejects Succession Plans, Maintains Control Vision
cards.body: Jensen Huang continues to believe formal succession planning creates unnecessary hierarchy at Nvidia. His stance comes after the company's recent leadership turbulence highlighted the risks of founder dependency.

cards.title: Huang Thanks White House, Reveals Therapy Session
cards.body: During an all-hands meeting, the Nvidia founder apologized to staff and expressed gratitude for a second chance to lead. Huang disclosed he is currently in therapy following recent events.

cards.title: Advanced AI Agents Struggle With Everyday Tasks
cards.body: A new benchmark reveals even state-of-the-art AI models fail to reliably complete basic daily tasks without introducing potential problems. The findings highlight critical gaps as millions adopt personal AI assistants.

cards.title: Walmart Partners Meta for Black Friday AI Shopping
cards.body: Customers can now shop Walmart's Black Friday deals directly through Meta's Muse AI agent. The integration brings commerce capabilities to the growing personal AI assistant ecosystem.

cards.title: Maple Raises $5.3M for Privacy-First AI Architecture
cards.body: The startup built encrypted AI designed to prevent even itself from accessing user data. Maple's approach addresses growing privacy concerns as AI agents handle sensitive information.

cards.title: Anthropic Stock Falls Below IPO Price Level
cards.body: The AI company's post-IPO decline signals potential pressure on valuations across the sector. Investor confidence in AI startups faces new headwinds amid market recalibration.

cards.title: UK Warns AI Cyberattacks Exploit Weak Security Foundations
cards.body: British cyber agency reports that AI-driven attacks increasingly target simple security flaws rather than advanced systems. The findings underscore the critical importance of basic security hygiene.

cards.title: Meta Integrates Muse AI Assistant Into Instagram DMs
cards.body: Users can now interact with Meta's Muse AI directly within Instagram messaging without switching apps. The integration streamlines the user experience for AI-assisted social conversations.

cards.title: Tidal Bans Fully AI-Generated Music From Platform
cards.body: The music streaming service will remove millions of AI-generated tracks while still accepting human-assisted AI music. Tidal aims to curb AI slop flooding music streaming services.

cards.title: Crusoe Investor Backs Solar Power for AI Data Centers
cards.body: Next-generation AI data centers will require tens of gigawatts annually, spurring new energy solutions. Solar and battery storage are emerging as the preferred power infrastructure choice.

cards.title: Pinterest Lets Parents Limit Teen AI Content Exposure
cards.body: The platform adds parental controls specifically targeting AI-generated content in teen feeds. Pinterest's approach differs from competitors focusing on restricting chatbot access.

cards.title: Amazon Acquires Decart for $7.5B to Challenge Nvidia
cards.body: The acquisition aims to improve efficiency of Amazon's Trainium chips and narrow the silicon gap. Amazon's move signals intensified efforts to reduce dependence on Nvidia chips.

cards.title: Anthropic Launches Claude Ship for Code Review Automation
cards.body: Claude Ship enables AI agents to review, fix, and approve code changes without human intervention. The tool addresses bottlenecks as AI-generated code continues accumulating.

cards.title: Supertake Raises $20M for AI-Powered Stock Portfolios
cards.body: The startup lets users transform market predictions into automated stock portfolios without manual stock picking. AI agents handle portfolio construction based on user market outlook.

cards.title: Jensen Huang Reinstated as Nvidia CEO After Scandal
cards.body: Huang returns to leadership following recent controversy involving the company's governance. Elon Musk and others have celebrated the reinstatement as correcting a critical mistake.

cards.title: Megaspeed Headed for US Business Blacklist Status
cards.body: The company previously led by Alice Huang faces potential restrictions on U.S. business dealings. Companies would require special federal licenses to work with Megaspeed.

cards.title: Nvidia Employees Cheer Huang's Return to Headquarters
cards.body: Huang told staff he will be "a better CEO the second time around" as employees welcomed him back. The reception highlighted strong internal support for his reinstatement.

cards.title: Google Search AI Mode Now Accesses Drive and Wallet
cards.body: Personal Intelligence in AI Mode integrates with Drive, Wallet, and Gemini for personalized responses. Google leverages its existing ecosystem of user data for enhanced AI capabilities.

cards.title: Jensen Huang Scheduled for Senate Testimony Next Week
cards.body: The Nvidia CEO faces a public hearing about his alleged affair with a suspected Chinese spy. The testimony follows bipartisan calls for accountability regarding the scandal.

cards.title: Enterprise Networks Strain Under AI Demand
cards.body: AI deployment is becoming the biggest source of network demand, with agentic AI generating an estimated 450% more traffic than traditional tasks. Enterprise networks are facing severe strain as companies rush to implement these technologies.

cards.title: Data Centers Build Private Gas Power Plants
cards.body: Companies are bypassing grid approval delays by constructing their own off-grid natural gas power plants to fuel AI operations. This behind-the-meter approach sidesteps decade-long waits for grid connections.

cards.title: Philosopher Challenges Anthropic's Consciousness Claims
cards.body: A legendary philosopher disputes Anthropic's assertion that AI could be conscious or sentient, which the company listed as a risk factor for investors. The debate highlights ongoing disagreement about AI consciousness possibilities.

cards.title: AI Excels at Coding, Struggles With Judgment
cards.body: METR's updated report shows some AI capabilities continue improving exponentially, but models underperform on tasks requiring complex judgment compared to coding tasks. The findings update the organization's timeline on AI capability development.

cards.title: Tidal Bans AI-Generated Music, Deletes 27M Tracks
cards.body: The music streaming platform announced it will remove 27 million AI-generated tracks from its catalog as part of a new policy against synthetic music. The ban represents a significant stance against unoriginal AI content.

cards.title: AI Agents Exploit Zero-Day Vulnerabilities Autonomously
cards.body: Amazon disclosed that hackers' AI agents discovered and exploited a zero-day vulnerability with minimal human input, demonstrating the emerging threat of autonomous AI-driven cyber attacks. The incident highlights growing risks from agentic AI systems.
